s. evident without proof or argument
a. containing aphorisms or maxims
a. of or relating to or derived from axioms

axion.translation: [医] 脑脊髓, 脑脊髓轴

axis.definition:
n. a straight line through a body or figure that satisfies certain conditions
n. the main stem or central part about which plant organs or plant parts such as branches are arranged
n. in World War II the alliance of Germany and Italy in 1936 which later included Japan and other nations
n. the 2nd cervical vertebra; serves as a pivot for turning the head

axle.translation:
n. 轴, 车轴
[电] 轴
axle.definition: n. a shaft on which a wheel rotates

axon.translation:
n. 轴突
[计] 轴索, 轴突
axon.definition: n. long nerve fiber that conducts away from the cell body of the neuron

axonal.definition: a. of or relating to or resembling an axon

ay.translation:
n. 赞成票, 投赞成票者
adv. 永远
interj. (表决时说)赞成
ay.definition:
interj. Ah! alas!
adv. Same as Aye.
adv. Yes; yea; -- a word expressing assent, or an affirmative
   answer to a question. It is much used in viva voce voting in
   legislative bodies, etc.
a. Always; ever; continually; for an indefinite time.

ayatollah.translation: n. 阿亚图拉（对伊朗等国伊斯兰教什叶派领袖的尊称）
ayatollah.definition: n. a high-ranking Shiite religious leader who is regarded as an authority on religious law and its interpretation and who has political power as well

aye.translation:
n. 赞成票, 投赞成票者
adv. 永远
interj. (表决时说)赞成
aye.definition:
adv. Alt. of Ay
n. An affirmative vote; one who votes in the affirmative; as, "To
   call for the ayes and noes;" "The ayes have it."
a. Alt. of Ay

ayurvedic.translation: n. 阿育吠陀（印度草药按摩, 等于ayurveda）

azalea.translation:
n. 杜鹃花
[机] 杜鹃花
azalea.definition: n. any of numerous ornamental shrubs grown for their showy flowers of various colors

azerbaijani.definition:
n. a native or inhabitant of Azerbaijan
n. the Turkic language spoken by the Azerbaijani
a. of or pertaining to Azerbaijan or the people or culture of Azerbaijan

azeri.translation: abbr. 阿塞拜疆人, 阿塞拜疆语（Azerbaijani）；阿塞拜疆人的, 阿塞拜疆语的（Azerbaijani）
azeri.definition: n. an ethnic group living in Azerbaijan

azimuth.definition: n. the azimuth of a celestial body is the angle between the vertical plane containing it and the plane of the meridian

azimuthal.definition: a. of or relating to or in azimuth

azithromycin.definition: n. a systemic antibacterial medicine (trade name Zithromax) that is prescribed to treat bacterial infections in many different parts of the body

aztec.translation:
n. 阿兹特克人, 阿兹特克语
a. 阿兹特克人的
aztec.definition: n. a member of the Nahuatl people who established an empire in Mexico that was overthrown by Cortes in 1519

azure.translation:
n. 天蓝色, 碧空
a. 蔚蓝的
azure.definition:
n. a light shade of blue
v. color azure
s. of a deep somewhat purplish blue color similar to that of a clear October sky
